part.text:
## Summary

Added incremental builds and caching to the SSG without touching the existing plugin architecture or `buildSite()` path:

- **`src/cache.ts`** — hash utilities (source content hash, combined templates-dir hash) and a `.ssg-cache.json` manifest loader/saver that gracefully falls back to a clean build on missing/corrupt/version-mismatched cache.
- **`src/incremental.ts`** — `buildSiteIncremental(options, { clean })`: reads+hashes each markdown source cheaply, reuses cached `Page` (parsed frontmatter) and skips re-parsing/re-rendering/re-writing when both the source hash and templates hash match and the output file still exists; rebuilds otherwise. Invalidates all pages when any layout/partial changes, cleans up stale output for deleted source files, and reports `{ pagesBuilt, pagesSkipped, totalPages, elapsedMs, timeSavedMs, clean }`. Rendered HTML on disk *is* the cache — unchanged pages' files are left alone rather than duplicated into the manifest.
- **`src/cli.ts`** — new `--incremental` and `--clean` flags on `ssg build`; incremental is only wired for the default plugin pipeline (a warning is printed if combined with `--config`, and it falls back to a normal build).
- **`src/plugins/templatePlugin.ts`** — exported `writeFile`/`DEFAULT_STYLESHEET` so `incremental.ts` reuses them instead of duplicating logic.
- **`src/index.ts`** — exported the new incremental/cache API.
- **`tests/incremental.test.ts`** — 15 new tests covering clean build, full skip, single-page rebuild on source change, template-change invalidation (rebuilds all), `--clean`, missing/corrupt cache, deleted-output forcing rebuild, stale source cleanup, and CLI wiring.

Verified manually end-to-end too (clean build → all-skip → single-page rebuild on edit), and `tsc --noEmit` compiles clean.
